content.short: Yoki Finance enables seamless automation of recurring crypto payments.
content.description: There is currently no simple way to receive and set up recurring payments in crypto. Fiat recurring payments remain expensive for businesses, difficult to obtain, and hard for end users to manage. Yoki Finance provides a shared framework of smart contracts that enables businesses to build a broad range of recurring-payment solutions tailored to the needs of different audiences and industries, all built on the same underlying contracts.
content.meta: Yoki Finance is a Web3 solution that empowers users to seamlessly automate recurring crypto payments. Discover Yoki Finance and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
